rationale: C02 is the strongest reusable drafting template because both directives expand an existing national emergency and then employ nearly the same section-by-section sequence and extensive verbatim language: property blocking and designation criteria; suspension of immigrant and nonimmigrant entry through the same earlier directive; prohibition of IEEPA donations; contribution and services restrictions; evasion and conspiracy prohibitions; definitions; waiver of prior notice based on instantaneous asset transfers; and Treasury implementation, redelegation, and agency direction. The child adapts this machinery to Libya and adds Libya-specific designation grounds and a United Nations resolution provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I ... hereby expand the scope of the national emergency declared in [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... and thereby constitute an unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security and foreign policy of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I ... hereby expand the scope of the national emergency declared in [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... and thereby constitute an unusual and extraordinary threat to the national security and foreign policy of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The directives share the same expansion-of-an-existing-emergency framing and threat finding.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Section 1. (a) All property and interests in property that are in the United States ... are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Section 1. (a) All property and interests in property that are in the United States ... are blocked and may not be transferred, paid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State
shared_material.explanation: This is essentially identical operative asset-blocking machinery, followed in both orders by support and ownership-or-control designation criteria.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Sec. 2. I hereby find that the unrestricted immigrant and nonimmigrant entry into the United States of aliens determined to meet one or more of the criteria in section 1(a) ... would be detrimental ... and I hereby suspend entry

shared_material.explanation: The entry-suspension provision appears in the same position and uses virtually identical wording and the same cross-referenced framework.
